message.content: **MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation**, one of the largest publicly‑traded companies listed on the NASDAQ exchange. On Yahoo Finance you’ll see “MSFT” next to all of Microsoft’s financial data—stock price charts, earnings reports, analyst ratings, news articles, and other company filings. It serves as the unique identifier that investors use when buying, selling, or researching Microsoft shares through brokerage platforms, trading apps, or financial websites.
